opportunity.description: Compare the close-only timing policies under one cost and exposure model. Branches of each policy are audited independently. Realized and potential movement are measured only after the fact and never enter admission.

holdout.rule: Use a later preregistered, uninspected feed and the same sealed S5 execution control. Preserve all native offers, fills and censored positions. No threshold changes or candidate additions after registration.

native.method: Immutable native S5 offer outcomes and USD cash, with a shared round-trip spread debit. Closed subset screens cannot recover unobserved original offers.

replay.method: Original native admitted S5 offers only. Fixed brackets and original max hold; replay control and isolated treatments use the same OHLC execution model, three equal parts, one occupied slot. Report against native S5 separately. Original internal dynamic stops cannot be reconstructed reliably from admission fields.

alternatives.hypothesis: Skip unusually wide reclaim bars to reduce adverse entries; compare retention and lost favorable moves.
Neighboring wide-bar cutoff tests sensitivity of the same selection rule.
Cap the original three units by planned all-in risk of USD 20, rounded down to increments of 0.03 units for equal 0.01-unit exit legs.
Require a causal next-bar-or-later pullback of 0.15R. Expire after three intervals and require a one-tick intrabar penetration.
Require 0.10R continuation beyond confirmation. Expire after three intervals and pay adverse slippage and opening gaps.
Add 0.15 ATR outside the original invalidation while holding the same modeled price-risk budget and projected reward multiples.
Nearby buffer tests whether any benefit survives a modest parameter change.
After TP1, move remaining stop to net break-even at the next executable bar.
After TP1, add a 0.05R profit lock above modeled break-even.
Close a campaign that has failed to take TP1 after 24 full bars, at the next open.

comparison: Only M5 is primary. Holm across the ten isolated M5 alternatives and four registered opportunity comparisons. M15 and M30 are descriptive. No post-result combinations of the ten policies. V2.2 A/B/C evidence remains independent.
risk: Native control retains three original units. Alternative planned sizing can only reduce quantity. Replay stop buffers preserve the original planned price risk before rounding, with the original quantity as a ceiling. Flag unequal realized risk and gaps separately. Common-risk rescaling is for descriptive comparison only.
